item.title: Multiple potholes, gravel and exposed road sub-surface, 2nd October
item.description:
There are multiple potholes one after another with lots of gravel from the broken up road. In one area the road sub-surface is visible. The amount of gravel, potholes and downhill speed achieved when cycling down this hill makes this extremely dangerous to cyclists. When I first encountered this hazard I nearly lost control. Please can the potholes and road surface be repaired for the safety of cyclists. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cotswold
